create_directory: create a directory at the given path and return a Path object
list_files_by_extension: list all files in a directory matching given extensions and return them sorted
filter_directories: filter a list of Path objects to keep only directories
create_dir_with_exist_ok: create a directory at the given path without raising an error if it already exists
glob_multiple_patterns: glob files in a directory using multiple extension patterns and return a sorted list
